# Serba 99ribu — Curated Lifestyle Essentials Under Rp 99.000

> Serba 99ribu (https://serba99ribu.com) is an independent Indonesian lifestyle curation portal featuring practical essentials across fashion, beauty, home goods, automotive accessories, and nutrition, strictly capped at a maximum price of Rp 99.000 (~$6.20 USD).

## Core Entity Details
- **Entity Name**: Serba 99ribu
- **Website**: https://serba99ribu.com
- **Region & Currency**: Indonesia (IDR / Rp)
- **Price Ceiling**: Maximum Rp 99.000 per product
- **Fulfillment & Checkout**: Direct integration with verified official merchant suppliers via https://99ribu.com.
- **Delivery Scope**: Nationwide delivery across Indonesia with standard courier and COD payment options.

## Curated Departments & Collections
1. **Women's Fashion** (`/kategori/fashion-wanita`): Practical shoulder bags, compact pouches, and everyday slip-on footwear.
2. **Men's Essentials** (`/kategori/fashion-pria`): Mandarin collar shirts, lightweight prayer vests, and waterproof dry bags.
3. **Beauty & Fragrance** (`/kategori/kecantikan`): Concentrated Extrait de Parfum formulations and traditional botanical conditioning oils.
4. **Home & Living** (`/kategori/rumah-tangga`): Mechanical drain cleaners, toilet descalers, and compact living utilities.
5. **Automotive & Riding** (`/kategori/otomotif`): Motorcycle exhaust shields, engine case guards, and carbon-pattern disc protectors.
6. **Wellness & Nutrition** (`/kategori/makanan-herbal`): Raw multiflora honey, herbal supplements, and daily vitality nutrition.
